original.label: 01 / CANVAS THIGH / RECOMMENDED
caption: Low profile and directly compatible with the existing right-thigh carry socket.
Canvas, olive webbing and a restrained blue repair patch echo the backpack.

variants.label: 02 / LEATHER HIP
caption: Fast access and a strong civilian silhouette, but less compatible with the thigh socket.
Leather, canvas and brass feel practical without becoming tactical.

variants.label: 03 / SATCHEL THIGH
caption: Most closely linked to the salvaged backpack language and Montreal weathering.
Needs simplification before modelling: two thigh straps, not three.
